tldr: Lilith in Aries: the wound around respect and independence; shame processed as anger.
body: With Lilith in Aries, rejection converts straight into fight. Feeling overlooked or ordered around triggers a fierce, competitive reaction: independence at all costs, battles picked to prove worth, passion that overrides logic when the old feeling of being disrespected flares.
gift: Raw courage, drive, and the capacity for real independence once the fight stops needing an opponent.
challenge: Self-priority that reads as selfishness, pointless confrontations fought just to win, rage in place of feeling, never feeling respected enough.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
